title: Census of the Levitical clans
description: Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation mustered the Levites from the three clans: Kohath, Gershon, and Merari. These were all men between 30 and 50 years old who were fit for service in the tent of meeting. The Kohathites numbered 2,750, the Gershonites 2,630, and the Merarites 3,200—a total of 8,580 Levites.
